basic_info.description: Nestled between Chestnut Street and Magnolia, this captivating 3BR/3.5BA residence stands as one of the Marina's most elegant homes with an extraordinarily spacious and private backyard, a true oasis in the city. The home's ornate French-inspired facade gracefully opens into an expansive floor plan, centered around a peaceful atrium, elegant living room with Palladian windows and fireplace, and the formal dining room. Extensive enhancements have elevated the home's refined livability, including the gourmet kitchen, upgraded electrical system, refreshed bathrooms, three-car garage, and the addition of a fully equipped kitchenette downstairs-perfect for entertaining. Thoughtfully chosen interior details with white oak floors, custom interior doors, widened doorways, tailored closet spaces, fresh lighting, enhanced landscaping. Three spacious bedrooms include the primary suite with custom walk-in closet, luxurious bath, walk-out deck overlooking the garden. The lower level unfolds into a living area/media room with direct garden access, kitchenette, office space, guest suite, laundry room, and space for a gym or playroom. The rear yard is enchanting and useful, with patio, flat lawn, pathway, and a romantic pergola.
